scope: Bytes publication and capabilities; public object-bridge observations remain separate from native atomic and HGL any conformance.

expectations.bytes: Present empty bytes, equal repeats and changed contents publish; absent inputs do not. Delta equals the whole bytes value. Dense results retain the input horizon; raw no-output results remain visible.
expectations.byte_constructor: List octets 0..255 construct exact bytes; -1 and 256 fail. Byte content equality and lexicographic order preserve unsigned octets.
expectations.any_bridge: Mixed object payload types may publish through an object-typed reference API. This is not evidence for HGL any boxing or a present empty box. Capture independence must be measured rather than assumed for mutable objects.
expectations.native_atomic: Python bridge class values do not establish a registered native C++ atomic provider; public availability/errors are retained only.
